facts.text: I want to educate my children about safe behavior and injury prevention without generating fear or anxiety.
I want suggestions for how to make safety and injury prevention fun for kids.
I plan to try games and role-play to make safety fun with my kids.
I plan to incorporate safety into my everyday routine.
I plan to play "I Spy" with safety features like smoke detectors or first aid kits.
I want suggestions for creative ways to teach my kids about staying safe.
I plan to go on a field trip to a fire station or police station with my kids.
I plan to incorporate safety into my daily conversations.
I plan to remind my kids to wash their hands and wear a mask as part of everyday safety education.

keyphrases: creative ways to teach staying safe
